==English== {{wp|reconciliation}} ===Alternative forms=== * {{l|en|reconciliate}} {{q|uncommon}} ===Etymology=== {{ety|en|:bor|la:reconciliō|text=+|tree=1}} ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˈɹɛkənsaɪl/|a=RP}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈɹɛkənˌsaɪl/|a=GA,CA}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-reconcile.ogg|a=California}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈɹekənsɑel/|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈɹekənsaɪl/|[ˈɹekənsɑe̯l]|a=NZ}} * {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈkɒnsaɪl/}} ===Verb=== {{en-verb}} # {{lb|en|ambitransitive}} To [[restore]] a [[friendly]] [[relationship]]; to bring back or return to [[harmony]]. #: {{ux|en|to '''reconcile''' people who have quarrelled}} #: {{ux|en|to wait until others have '''reconciled'''}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To make things [[compatible]] or [[consistent]]. #: {{co|en|to '''reconcile''' differences}} #* {{RQ:Locke Education|2015 |passage=The great men among the ancients understood how to '''reconcile''' manual labour with affairs of state.}} #* {{RQ:Pope Essay on Criticism|passage=Some Figures monstrous and mis-shap'd appear,
Consider'd singly, or beheld too near,
Which, but proportion'd to their Light, or Place,
Due Distance '''reconciles''' to Form and Grace}} # {{lb|en|accounting|transitive}} To make the net difference in [[credit]]s and [[debit]]s of a [[financial]] [[account]] [[agree]] with the [[balance]]. ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|irreconcile|reconcilee|reconcilement|reconciler|unreconcile|unreconciled |reconciliation|reconcilable|reconcilability|reconcilingly|unreconciling }} ====Related terms==== {{col3|en|conciliate}} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|to restore a friendly relationship (transitive)}} * Albanian: * Arabic: * Armenian: * Azerbaijani: * Bulgarian: * Comorian: * Czech: * Dutch: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Gothic: * Greek: * Hungarian: * Italian: * Japanese: * Kazakh: * Korean: * Norwegian: * Old English: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Romagnol: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t+|ru|помири́ться|pf}}, {{t+|ru|помири́ть|pf}}, {{t+|ru|примири́ть|pf}}, {{t+|ru|примиря́ть|impf}}, {{t+|ru|примири́ться|pf}}, {{t+|ru|примиря́ться|impf}} * Spanish: * Swahili: * Swedish: * Tagalog: * Thai: * Turkish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to make things compatible or consistent}} * Albanian: * Arabic: * Azerbaijani: * Bulgarian: * Chinese: * Czech: * Dutch: * Egyptian: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Greek: * Hungarian: * Italian: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Quechua: * Romanian: * Spanish: * Swedish: * Tagalog: * Yiddish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to make the net difference in credits and debits of a financial account agree with the balance}} * Bulgarian: * Chinese: * Czech: * Esperanto: * Finnish: * Italian: * Polish: {{trans-bottom}} ===References=== {{reflist}}
